# POST /api/v1/admin/unadopted/{owner}/{repo}

Adopts unadopted files on disk as a repository tracked in the database

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (token with AccessTokenScopeCategoryAdmin) · **ID:** `ep-108`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Non-admin user
- **404** — User not found, repo already in DB, or git repo not on disk
- **500** — DB error or adoption failure

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | admin.AdoptRepository | controller | Get owner username and repo name from path; Lookup user by name; Check repo does NOT exist in DB; Check git repo DOES exist on disk; Call repo_service.AdoptRepository |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | repo_service.AdoptRepository | service | Check user can create repo (limit check); Create repository record in DB (transaction); Adopt git repo: create delegate hooks, sync branches, sync releases; Update git repo after create; Set repository status to Ready; Send notification |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| All endpoints require site admin privilege (reqSiteAdmin middleware) | authorization | User must be site admin |
| Adopt requires repo NOT in DB but EXISTS on disk | validation | has (in DB) || !exist (on disk) |
| Adopted repos are always created as private | business_logic | Always when adopting |
| User must not have reached repo creation limit to adopt | eligibility | !doer.CanCreateRepoIn(owner) |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Owner username not found | 404 | notFound | False |
| Repo in DB or not on filesystem | 404 | notFound | False |
| Git operations or DB insert fails | 500 | internal error | True |

### Error Paths

- **User not found** → admin.AdoptRepository → 404
- **Repo already in DB or not on disk** → admin.AdoptRepository → 404
- **Adoption failure** → admin.AdoptRepository → 500
